title: Day 695 — Government Formally Files Dual-Nationality Ban for President, Governors, CDMX Mayor
detail: On August 27, 2026 (Day 695, Thursday), the Sheinbaum government formally filed the constitutional reform initiative it had previewed on August 25, requiring candidates for the presidency, state governorships and the Mexico City head of government to hold only Mexican nationality by birth. Presidential Legal Advisor Luisa María Alcalde presented the details: dual nationals must renounce their other citizenship before registering as a candidate, presidential aspirants must show at least 20 years of residency in Mexico, and officeholders would be barred from acquiring another nationality or invoking foreign diplomatic protection while in office, with constitutional sanctions for violations. Sheinbaum said the goal is to guarantee that the interest of the nation stands above that of any other state. The initiative, prompted by the case of fugitive former Tamaulipas governor Francisco Javier García Cabeza de Vaca, now goes to Congress for debate.

media.caption: Legal advisor Luisa María Alcalde presents the formal dual-nationality reform initiative

title: Day 695 — Sheinbaum Announces $5M+ Recovered From García Luna-Linked Weinberg Network
detail: On August 27, 2026 (Day 695, Thursday), President Sheinbaum announced that Mexico's Financial Intelligence Unit (UIF) had recovered more than $5 million from a network of companies tied to Mauricio Samuel Weinberg López and Jonathan Alexis Weinberg Pinto, identified as associates and front men for former Public Security Secretary Genaro García Luna. She said UIF chief Omar Reyes Colmenares would return the next day to explain the recovery mechanism in detail. The recovery adds to a $578.5 million May 2026 Florida civil judgment in Mexico's favor over García Luna's illicit public-contracting scheme and prior 2025 criminal sentencing exceeding $2.448 billion, bringing total recoveries tied to the García Luna corruption network above $3.067 billion.

media.caption: Sheinbaum announces recovery of over $5 million tied to the García Luna corruption network

title: Day 695 — Sheinbaum Links US State Department Resignations to Push for Clarity on ICE Killings of Mexicans
detail: On August 27, 2026 (Day 695, Thursday), President Sheinbaum said resignations had occurred within the U.S. State Department amid efforts to clarify cases of Mexican nationals killed by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents. The remarks came on the eve of the anniversary of the killing of Silverio Villegas González by an ICE agent, one of several such cases Sheinbaum's government has pressed Washington to investigate.

media.caption: Sheinbaum discusses US State Department resignations tied to ICE killings of Mexican nationals
